meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we'll be quick. Who decided on the zero, and why did Owen find out from his phone in the middle of class?
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says its score shouldn't be the sole basis for acting against a student. What else do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a trip to the principal, so this is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing, because you gave her no evidence to weigh.
What cost ground: You led with the detector score as your whole basis, and she dismissed it as a machine's guess because the vendor itself warns against using it alone.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated document in front of her that she can check herself.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
